purpose: Language-neutral topical authority architecture. Locale files under data/seo/topical-authority/<locale>.json hold native-language keyword hypotheses. Nothing here is a page, a Matrix row, a sitemap entry, a hreflang relation or a verified search-demand claim.

central_entity.label_en: Renting a motorbike or scooter in Hanoi
central_entity.kind: Informational guide topic (the site is an independent guide, not a rental provider)
never_claim: opening hours, premises or delivery areas
guaranteed legality, insurance cover or roadside help

hierarchy.name: Entity Hub
hierarchy.note: One per locale. Owns the head query (e.g. motorbike rental Hanoi). Existing live URL — protected by data/seo/url-freeze.json.

hierarchy.name: Topic Pillar
hierarchy.note: Four per locale (vehicle-choice, rental-costs, documents-contracts, safety-support). Repo role name stays HUB; do not rename live roles.

hierarchy.name: Cluster
hierarchy.note: Semantic sub-topic rendered as a section of its Topic Pillar that links to its Supporting guides. Never its own URL: no thin archive/category stubs.

hierarchy.name: Supporting
hierarchy.note: One question, one intent, one URL. Links up to its Topic Pillar and Entity Hub and sideways inside its Cluster, PUBLISHED targets only.

clusters.scope: Manual, semi-automatic and automatic two-wheelers: how they ride and who they suit.
Engine capacity and electric drive: 50cc, 110–125cc, 150cc+, electric scooters and what each means for routes and licences.
Widely sold Vietnamese-market model families explained as vehicle types (no availability claims).
Matching the bike to the rider and trip: passenger, luggage, rider experience, longer rides out of the city.
How rental periods (day, week, month, long term) change total cost and obligations.
Deposits, identity documents left as security, refund conditions and disputes.
Costs beyond the rental fee: fuel, parking, delivery, damage, late return.
Driving licence classes, foreign licences, International Driving Permits and licence conversion — always verified against current official sources.
Rental agreement clauses: changes, cancellation, damage and theft liability.
Compulsory civil liability insurance and how travel insurance may treat motorbike riding.
Papers to carry while riding: vehicle registration card, identity, licence.
Handover inspection and return condition. OWNED by the live /{locale}/checklist/ page — reserved intent.
Rain, flooding, heat, cold and fog in northern Vietnam.
Breakdowns, flat tyres, accidents, theft and traffic police stops.
Riding in Hanoi itself: traffic behaviour, rules, parking, night riding and city restrictions.

proposed_hubs.scope: Riding out of Hanoi on a rented bike (northern loops, day trips, one-way journeys).
proposed_hubs.why_review: The live taxonomy, navigation and Matrix contract fix four Hubs per locale. A fifth Hub needs an explicit owner architecture decision before any of its topics can enter the Matrix.

clusters.scope: Multi-day northern routes starting from Hanoi.

states.PUBLISHED: Matrix row PUBLISHED with generated HTML in the sitemap.
states.REVIEW: Matrix IDEA held as an unmerged authored draft (protected-drafts.json) or editorial PR.
states.SUBMITTED: Writer draft submitted with immutable SHA evidence, awaiting editorial review.
states.WRITING: Matrix IDEA claimed by an active Writer session.
states.PLANNED: Matrix IDEA, free for the Writer pool.
states.PROPOSED: Topical-map candidate only (this directory). Not in the Matrix, not claimable, not linkable.
states.ARCHITECTURE_BLOCKED: Topical-map candidate under a proposed Hub that still needs owner architecture approval.

link_rules: HTML links only to PUBLISHED URLs (enforced by scripts/nav-qa.mjs and scripts/seo/seo-guard.mjs).
Supporting → its Topic Pillar (HUB) and Entity Hub (PILLAR) once those are PUBLISHED.
Supporting → up to 3 PUBLISHED siblings in the same Cluster, then up to 2 in adjacent Clusters of the same Topic Pillar.
Topic Pillar → every PUBLISHED Supporting guide, grouped by Cluster section headings.
Entity Hub → every PUBLISHED Topic Pillar plus the checklist.
Anchor text = the target's native primary query or title wording; never generic 'click here'; never the same anchor for two different targets on one page.
No cross-locale body links except the language switcher and genuine-equivalent hreflang.

PILLAR: WebPage with inLanguage and isPartOf WebSite
HUB: about → the hub's Cluster entities in plain names
SUPPORT: FAQPage only when the FAQ is visible on the page

aeo_geo_rules: Open each Supporting guide with a 2–3 sentence direct answer to its primary question in the native language.
Use one question-shaped H2 per sub-question; keep each answer self-contained so it can be quoted.
Define entities explicitly on first mention (e.g. what a semi-automatic motorbike is).
Cite current official sources inline for legal, licence, insurance and safety statements, with the date checked.
State uncertainty plainly instead of guessing: rules change, providers differ.
Visible FAQ (3–6 items) that does not repeat the H2s.
localization_rules: Each locale keeps its own keyword hypotheses, search intent, slug, title and market notes; never copy one locale's query list into another.
Cross-locale duplicate queries or titles fail validation (catches untranslated copies).
Market-specific subjects are expected: the same Cluster may hold different questions in different languages.
Script checks: ja must use Japanese script, zh Han without kana, ko Hangul, vi Vietnamese diacritics in titles.
